name: @kyora-sh/review
description: Multi-engine AI code review — your own coding-agent subscriptions (Codex, Claude, Kimi, Grok, Qwen) reviewing PRs together, with consensus filtering and adversarial verification

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --minify && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bun\n' | cat - ./dist/index.js > ./dist/tmp.js && mv ./dist/tmp.js ./dist/index.js && chmod +x ./dist/index.js
